name: Haunted Halls
source:
Two sisters, Emma and Elizabeth, have recently moved out to Indiana with their parents. Completely isolated, they wonder what there is to do in this turn of the century home.

Inspired by the eerie feeling I get every time I visit Indiana to see relatives.

[From [url=https://necropocene.itch.io/haunted-halls]Itch.io[/url]]
